notes.title: Rat HQ Update
notes.notes:
On June 6th we will be celebrating our 16th anniversary since launching WWII Online, that's awesome! We have a lot of activities happening; so today I will be addressing our Steam progress, additional power inbound to one of our server cabinets on this Sunday and finally provide you with a YouTube video of our highly engaging / interactive Rat Chat we had this last weekend!
 
[h1]STEAM PROGRESS[/h1]
Steam users will be having their very own game client, we've chosen to do this to make things much easier on their end and work with the Steam flow much easier. So new users coming from Steam will not be required to launch the Playgate as our (organic) current users do. Actually signing up for an account and managing that account will also be a bit different, all of that is being worked on as we speak and is making really solid progress.

Currently we're in the "Coming Soon" to Steam category and we're already gaining some awareness in preparation for our actual Early Access launch day. This is great because it's already building up a bit of a fan base, in fact we have (as of this writing) 1,446 members part of our Steam group, welcome aboard everyone!

[h1]LOCALIZATION TEAM[/h1]
We realized really quickly that we needed form a Localization team, to help us translate our announcements and game information to many other languages. We're pleased to report that we have adapted rapidly to this demand and we're now offering multiple translations on our Steam store, and we're going to be working on additional translations for our actual game client.

If you speak a language other than English, please send us an e-mail at jobs@playnet.com with some information about you and the language(s) you speak fluently.

[h1]ADDITIONAL POWER FOR SERVER CABINET[/h1]
Game services will be brought offline by 7PM US Central this coming Sunday June 4th 2017. We will be replacing the power distribution units of an entire cabinet that we have. This will provide is with double the power capacity, and bring our entire infrastructure up to maximum power. You should expect this to take the duration of the evening.

[h1]ISP CHANGE COMING SOON (MID-JUNE)[/h1]
We've recently installed our new Gigabit line but have been working on all of the networking and routing / configuration rules in prep to swap things over from our two 100 Megabit lines. We will keep you posted on this but there will be a 24 hour propagation period (based on your ISP) that will make services hard to reach. This will increase our bandwidth ceiling by a factor of 10x and is required for the Steam release.

[h1]RAT CHAT: MAY 27TH 2017[/h1]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bFOPnxvWnJE&t]Watch the full Rat Chat on our YouTube page (click here).[/url]

notes.title: Reminder: Join us for a chat with the devs on Saturday 5/27 !
notes.notes:
Hey Steam Friends!

Another quick update for you! We've still got a lot going on behind the scenes, but we're getting ready to let you under hood a bit this weekend!

The next big community event will be the RAT Chat taking place this Saturday, May 27, at 4PM server time (2pm US Pacific Time, 5pm US Eastern Time, 10pm GMT).

This RAT Chat will be a little bit different from the chats we've had in the past. This time we will be utilizing the same software we use internally for our team meetings and using its webinar function to be able to bring in as many of you as we can! 

Using the software to set up the webinar format will allow us to have the most interactive RAT Chat that we've ever been able to do! The RATs will be able to have a visual element (slides, in development screenshots, etc.) in addition to the traditional audio presentations and Q&A. 

Because we'll be using proper presentation software, it will also allow us to stream the RAT Chat live on Facebook and YouTube (and maybe some other places too if we feel like it!)

All of this adds up to us being able to bring you more information in a better format, and hopefully it allows you all to get a little more insight into what's currently going on at RAT HQ!

Stay tuned for the information on how to join us! 

Feel free to check out our Facebook page! It's a great way to stay up to date with all the latest news. You can find us at facebook.com/battlegroundeurope

notes.title: You're Invited! A special message from CRS!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Another quick update from RAT HQ! 

We've been busy this week working on getting the Steam Store page launched. As you can see, we've accomplished that goal! 

This also means that our game community hub is active! 

As you may know, our community is very near and dear to our hearts as a development team. Pretty much all of the devs that are currently working on WWII Online came from the community as players!

We're excited to have a place on Steam to welcome the Steam community and interact with everyone!

To that end we're gearing up for something special and want to make sure that everyone in the Steam community is invited! 

Every once in a while, our dev team likes to sit down and spend some time talking to and answering questions from our community. Since we're known around the community as "The Rats" (we got this moniker from the name of our studio, Cornered Rat Software), we've dubbed these events as "Rat Chats"

We're planning on holding our next Rat Chat on May 27, 2017 at 4pm US Central time (2pm US Pacific, 5pm US Eastern, 10pm GMT)

In the past, we've invited the community to join us on a voice server and have been able to chat about the game, development, and answer questions. 

We've been working on something special for this next one! We will be presenting in more of a "webinar" format where we will be able to share images and graphics with the community as well as chat about the game, development, and answer questions! 

We hope you'll make plans to join us on the 27th and learn first hand about all the work we're doing to get the game live on Steam as well as the other development we have coming down the pipe!

notes.title: Progress Report: Lots of back end work underway!
notes.notes:
Hey Steam Friends!

Things are still moving along at a blistering pace here at RAT HQ! Lots of back end work going on right now, so most of it is way over my head, but here's a quick rundown of some of the work that's taking place right now!

We've had another big week of infrastructure updates at our CoLo facility with our System Admin team. We just had a new internet connection dropped into our cages that will increase our incoming and outgoing bandwidth. 

This is another huge step in increasing our hardware capabilities and expanding our concurrent user capacity as we lead up to a release on Steam. 

There's still a lot of work to be done to get everything in tip top shape, but we're making great progress!

Our Dev team has been hard at work getting everything in place for all the back end integration to be ready to launch on Steam. There is a lot to do to integrate all the pieces into our existing game, but they're tackling the project head on, and progress is being made. 

Our Production team has also been working hard on a number of projects, including art and animation work, continuing work on the ongoing ballistics audit, and most exciting (for me at least) they are working on getting all the data sets and in game information put together for the new vehicles. We're getting closer to seeing those new models in game, and we can't wait to have they players get a hold of them!

That's about it for now. Lots to do, so I better get back to work!

If you're hungry for more information, there's always more news and information to dig into on our website, including our development roadmap so you can see what we're working towards!

Our community is why we're still around after all these years. Just by being here, you're a part of it! Join the discussion here, on the website, our forums, and social media! We love hearing from you!

S!

notes.title: New Player Experience and more infrastructure updates!
notes.notes:
Hi there Steam friends!

We've had another huge week at RAT HQ!

This week we've been busy rolling out the changes to the way that new players will be introduced to our game!

Now, new players signing up for an account will receive a 2 week premium trial. If these new players choose to not sign up for a premium subscription during the 2 week trial, their account will revert from premium status to a perpetual Free to Play subscription. Going forward, the Free to Play option will include Riflemen and access to trucks and heavy gun haulers.

Once we release on Steam, this will be the model that new players can expect.

We hope that this will give players an introduction into all of the aspects of our game and not get locked in to a limited Free to Play role without getting the opportunity to experience the other unique gameplay that our combined arms environment allows!

Our Comm-Dev team has also started an overhaul of our game wiki, which is the game manual to make sure that it is more helpful overall, and specifically to new players looking for some help. 

All in all, we're working hard to improve the experience of players when first entering the game. This is something that we as a development team have seen as an area of improvement for some time and it's something that we've commited ourselves to try to fix.

In addition to these changes, our System Admin team has had another big week of updating our systems at the CoLo facility. Just today we had a short downtime to upgrade the power that was being delivered to our cabinets in order to be able to add some more new hardware! This is another step that we needed to take to get us closer to our release on Steam!

Another week of great progress with a lot more to come! We are working hard to get ready for Steam and hope that you are getting excited to join us!

notes.title: Hello from Rat HQ!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam Friends!

I’m DAGGER from Cornered Rat Software and I wanted to stop by and let you know a little bit about what’s been going on at RAT HQ lately.

As you may be aware, we’re gearing up to release WWII Online on Steam this summer! 
Over the last several months our team has been working hard to get prepared for this big step in the long history of our game! 

Some of the most important prep work so far has been undertaken by our team of System Administrators and Developers to upgrade and reconfigure the game servers to allow us to bring all our users , new and old alike, together in one single game world!

You may think you’ve seen some big game arenas before, but the scale of WWII Online is something that has never really been matched in a MMOFPS. When you spawn into our game world, you are spawning into a half scale map of western Europe, with no instances. You can walk from Frankfurt to Calais (if you can manage to sneak through the front lines) without ever having to load into another instance.

To ensure that this single instance game world is available to as many users as possible, our SysAdmin and Dev teams have undertaken an impressive project to upgrade our server hardware and optimize our internal networking. This will allow us to expand our concurrent user capacity with the goal being that every player that joins the game will join a single campaign and fight in the same war!
In addition to all this intensive back end work, our Production team has also been hard at work.
